cues: Innate immunity is with you from birth: skin, mucus, stomach acid, phagocytes.
It is active when your own body makes the antibodies, after an infection or a vaccine, with memory that lasts.
It is passive when antibodies are handed over ready made: across the placenta, in colostrum, or as an antiserum.
text: Immunity. Innate immunity is with you from birth: skin, mucus, stomach acid, phagocytes. Acquired immunity is specific. It is active when your own body makes the antibodies, after an infection or a vaccine, with memory that lasts. It is passive when antibodies are handed over ready made: across the placenta, in colostrum, or as an antiserum. Quick, but short lived.
